# Run the analysis

## Your task

Generate descriptive summaries and figures.

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/02-analyse-example.R
```

| Output | File under `results/` |
|---|---|
| Counts, richness, Shannon diversity | `tables/alpha-diversity.tsv` |
| Full feature proportions | `tables/relative-abundance.tsv` |
| Plotting categories | `tables/composition-display.tsv` |
| Group summaries | `tables/group-summary.tsv` |
| Composition | `figures/composition.png` |
| Diversity | `figures/shannon-diversity.png` |
| Count totals versus diversity | `figures/depth-diversity.png` |

## Use your own data

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/02-analyse-example.R data/my-study results/my-study
```

The same script uses your identifiers and group labels, with no example-specific numeric values.

::: {.cdi-message}
**Full data for calculations; simplified data for display.** The composition plot shows the top eight features by mean sample proportion and combines the rest as Other. Diversity uses every feature.
:::

## Check before continuing

Check sample counts, proportions summing to one, count totals, and labels. These are descriptive results; no significance tests are performed. For very large studies, review plot readability and computing resources.
